subject.title: [Feature]: Allow Codex harness configured app-server provider IDs

question: Should the Codex plugin expose `plugins.entries.codex.config.appServer.providerIds` as the supported contract for routing custom Codex `model_providers` through the bundled harness?
rationale: The use case is valid from current source and Codex dependency contracts, but it creates a new config/default surface in provider routing.

options.title: Accept Allowlist With Parser Fix
options.body: Keep the new plugin-local allowlist only if the paired PR uses the strict Codex config parser and documents/tests the contract.

options.title: Prefer Config Discovery
options.body: Ask for a design that derives claimable provider IDs from Codex configuration or another existing provider contract.

options.title: Defer Custom Providers
options.body: Keep the harness limited to `codex` and `openai` until maintainers explicitly support custom Codex model providers.

recommendation.title: Accept Allowlist With Parser Fix
recommendation.body: Keep the new plugin-local allowlist only if the paired PR uses the strict Codex config parser and documents/tests the contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The Codex app-server harness history and config-boundary ownership trail point most strongly to this owner.
